segments.cnd16:3.3: Sā taṇhā buddhassa bhagavato chinnā ucchinnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhā.
segments.cnd16:3.6: Yo rāgo sārāgo …pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.cnd16:3.7: Sā ejā taṇhā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.cnd16:3.9: Ejāya pahīnattā anejo bhagavā lābhepi na iñjati, alābhepi na iñjati, yasepi na iñjati, ayasepi na iñjati, pasaṃsāyapi na iñjati, nindāyapi na iñjati, sukhepi na iñjati, dukkhepi na iñjati na calati na vedhati na pavedhati na sampavedhatīti.
segments.cnd16:4.2: Yo rāgo sārāgo…pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.cnd16:4.3: Sā nandī sā taṇhā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.cnd16:4.5: Oghatiṇṇanti bhagavā kāmoghaṃ tiṇṇo bhavoghaṃ tiṇṇo diṭṭhoghaṃ tiṇṇo avijjoghaṃ tiṇṇo sabbasaṃsārapathaṃ tiṇṇo uttiṇṇo nitthiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivatto.
segments.cnd16:4.6: So vutthavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo…pe… jātimaraṇasaṃsāro natthi tassa punabbhavoti –
segments.cnd16:4.8: Vimuttanti bhagavato rāgā cittaṃ muttaṃ vimuttaṃ suvimuttaṃ, dosā cittaṃ… mohā cittaṃ…pe…
segments.cnd16:5.6: Buddhassa bhagavato taṇhākappo pahīno diṭṭhikappo paṭinissaṭṭho.
segments.cnd16:5.7: Taṇhākappassa pahīnattā diṭṭhikappassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā tasmā buddho kappañjaho.
segments.cnd16:5.8: Abhiyāceti yācāmi abhiyācāmi ajjhesāmi sādiyāmi patthayāmi pihayāmi jappāmi abhijappāmi.
segments.cnd16:5.10: Yā paññā pajānanā…pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
segments.cnd16:5.11: Bhagavā imāya medhāya paññāya upeto samupeto upāgato samupāgato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato.
segments.cnd16:6.3: Bhagavā āguṃ na karotīti nāgo, na gacchatīti nāgo, na āgacchatīti nāgo…pe… evaṃ bhagavā na gacchatīti nāgo.
segments.cnd16:6.4: Sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti itoti tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusāsanaṃ anusiṭṭhaṃ sutvā suṇitvā uggahetvā upadhārayitvā upalakkhayitvā ito apanamissanti vajissanti pakkamissanti disāvidisaṃ gamissantīti –
segments.cnd16:8.4: tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
segments.cnd16:9.2: Nānājanāti khattiyā ca brāhmaṇā ca vessā ca suddā ca gahaṭṭhā ca pabbajitā ca devā ca manussā ca.
segments.cnd16:9.3: Janapadehi saṅgatāti aṅgā ca magadhā ca kaliṅgā ca kāsiyā ca kosalā ca vajjiyā ca mallā ca cetiyamhā ca [cetiyamhā ca sāgaramhā ca (syā.)] vaṃsā ca kurumhā ca pañcālā ca macchā ca surasenā ca assakā ca avantiyā ca yonā [yonakā (ka.) mahāni. 55] ca kambojā ca.
segments.cnd16:10.3: Bhagavā vīriyavāti vīro, pahūti vīro, visavīti vīro, alamattoti vīro, vigatalomahaṃsotipi vīro.
segments.cnd16:12.1: Tava vīra vākyaṃ abhikaṅkhamānāti tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusāsanaṃ anusiṭṭhaṃ.
segments.cnd16:12.2: Abhikaṅkhamānāti abhikaṅkhamānā icchamānā sādiyamānā patthayamānā pihayamānā abhijappamānāti –
segments.cnd16:13.2: Tesanti tesaṃ khattiyānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vessānaṃ suddānaṃ gahaṭṭhānaṃ pabbajitānaṃ devānaṃ manussānaṃ.
segments.cnd16:13.4: Sādhu viyākarohīti sādhu ācikkhāhi desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehīti –
segments.cnd16:14.1: Tathā hi te vidito esa dhammoti tathā hi te vidito tulito tīrito vibhūto vibhāvito esa dhammoti –
segments.cnd16:14.2: tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
segments.cnd16:15.4: tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo”ti. 72.
segments.cnd16:17.3: Tāya taṇhāya rūpaṃ ādiyanti upādiyanti gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti.
segments.cnd16:17.13: vaṭṭaṃ ādiyanti upādiyanti gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti.
segments.cnd16:17.15: Ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabbanti sabbaṃ ādānataṇhaṃ vinayeyya paṭivinayeyya pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyāti –
segments.cnd16:19.1: Yaṃ yañhi lokasmimupādiyantīti yaṃ yaṃ rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ ādiyanti upādiyanti gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti.
segments.cnd16:20.1: Teneva māro anveti jantunti teneva kammābhisaṅkhāravasena paṭisandhiko khandhamāro dhātumāro āyatanamāro gatimāro upapattimāro paṭisandhimāro bhavamāro saṃsāramāro vaṭṭamāro anveti anugacchati anvāyiko hoti.
segments.cnd16:20.2: Jantunti sattaṃ janaṃ naraṃ māṇavaṃ [mānavaṃ (syā.)] posaṃ puggalaṃ jīvaṃ jāguṃ jantuṃ indaguṃ manujanti –
segments.cnd16:23.2: Tasmāti tasmā taṃkāraṇā taṃhetu tappaccayā taṃnidānā, etaṃ ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno ādānataṇhāyāti –
segments.cnd16:23.4: Pajānanti jānanto pajānanto ājānanto vijānanto paṭivijānanto paṭivijjhanto “sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti…pe…
segments.cnd16:23.5: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma”nti jānanto pajānanto ājānanto vijānanto paṭivijānanto paṭivijjhanto.
segments.cnd16:23.6: Na upādiyethāti rūpaṃ nādiyeyya na upādiyeyya na gaṇheyya na parāmaseyya nābhiniviseyya;
segments.cnd16:23.16: vaṭṭaṃ nādiyeyya na upādiyeyya na gaṇheyya na parāmaseyya nābhiniviseyyāti –
segments.cnd16:24.2: Bhikkhūti puthujjanakalyāṇako vā bhikkhu, sekkho vā bhikkhu.
segments.cnd16:24.7: Kiñcananti kiñci rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ.
segments.cnd16:24.8: Sabbaloketi sabbaapāyaloke sabbamanussaloke sabbadevaloke sabbakhandhaloke sabbadhātuloke sabbaāyatanaloketi –
segments.cnd16:25.1: Ādānasatte iti pekkhamānoti ādānasattā vuccanti ye rūpaṃ ādiyanti upādiyanti gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti;
segments.cnd16:25.11: vaṭṭaṃ ādiyanti upādiyanti gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti.
segments.cnd16:25.13: Pekkhamānoti pekkhamāno dakkhamāno dissamāno passamāno olokayamāno nijjhāyamāno upaparikkhamānoti –
segments.cnd16:26.2: Pajāti sattādhivacanaṃ maccudheyyā vuccanti kilesā ca khandhā ca abhisaṅkhārā ca.
segments.cnd16:26.3: Pajā maccudheyye māradheyye maraṇadheyye sattā visattā āsattā laggā laggitā palibuddhā.
segments.cnd16:26.4: Yathā bhittikhile vā nāgadante vā bhaṇḍaṃ sattaṃ visattaṃ āsattaṃ laggaṃ laggitaṃ palibuddhaṃ, evameva pajā maccudheyye māradheyye maraṇadheyye sattā visattā āsattā laggā laggitā palibuddhāti –

lines: Ekā eva hi sā taṇhā, thutivasena idha nānappakārato vuttā.
Sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti itoti nāgassa tava bhagavato vacanaṃ sutvā ito pāsāṇakacetiyato bahujanā pakkamissantīti adhippāyo.
Athassa āsayānulomena dhammaṃ desento bhagavā uparūparigāthāyo abhāsi.
Tattha ādānataṇhanti rūpādīnaṃ ādāyikaṃ gahaṇataṇhaṃ, taṇhupādānanti vuttaṃ hoti.
Yaṃ yañhi lokasmimupādiyantīti etesu uddhādibhedesu yaṃ yaṃ gaṇhanti.
Teneva māro anveti jantunti teneva upādānapaccayanibbattakammābhisaṅkhāranibbattavasena paṭisandhikkhandhamāro taṃ sattaṃ anugacchati. 73.
Tasmā pajānanti tasmā etamādīnavaṃ aniccādivasena vā saṅkhāre pajānanto.

Ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattanti ādātabbaṭṭhena ādānesu rūpādīsu satte sabbaloke imaṃ pajaṃ maccudheyye laggaṃ pekkhamāno, ādānasatte vā ādānābhiniviṭṭhe puggale ādānasaṅgahetuñca imaṃ pajaṃ maccudheyye laggaṃ tato vītikkamituṃ asamatthaṃ iti pekkhamāno kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke na upādiyethāti.

after.title: Bhadrāvudhamāṇavasuttaniddesavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ bhagavā idampi suttaṃ arahattanikūṭeneva desesi, desanāpariyosāne ca pubbasadiso eva dhammābhisamayo ahosīti.
